info.title: Expect Less Output local agent API
info.description: Runs inside the Expect Less Output app on 127.0.0.1 only. Off until the owner turns it on in Settings. Send the token as "Authorization: Bearer <token>". Scheduled posts only go out while the app is running. Agents can never connect accounts, change credentials, or delete files.

post.summary: Create a post from a video file. Creates a draft unless agents are allowed to schedule.
post.description: The video is copied into the brand Queue folder. Owner token, or an orchestrator bot (such as beth) on a channel it may work on. Status scheduled with no time goes to the first open slot of every platform. Give scheduled_at (every platform) or platform_times (one platform) for an exact time, which is used as it is, on or off a slot. While the app setting "Agents may create drafts only" is on, asking for status scheduled or next_slot true is refused with HTTP 403 and code drafts_only. Nothing is silently downgraded.

post.summary: Create a draft Etsy listing (title, description, tags, price, images, digital file).
post.description: Only the beth bot token and the owner token may call this. The listing is always a draft: there is no way to activate it from here, a person does that on Etsy. Limits: title up to 140 characters, up to 13 tags of up to 20 characters, price at least 20 cents, up to 10 images, one optional digital file. Images are file paths inside the Media Root (or the ventures-uploads folder in the ELO data folder) or public https links, picture types only, up to 20 MB each; the digital file is a file path in those same folders, up to 20 MB. Anything else is refused with 400. Send taxonomyId (the Etsy category) unless a default is set, and shippingProfileId for a physical item. While no Etsy shop is connected the draft is kept in ELO as pending and sent after the shop is connected (pending is true in the answer). Every call is logged with who, what and when.

400.description: The request did not match the schema.

403.description: Not allowed. For example code drafts_only while agents are limited to drafts.

patch.description: Only the beth bot token and the owner token may call this. Only drafts can be changed: a listing that is active, inactive or expired is refused with 403 drafts_only. Send any of title, description, tags, priceCents, quantity, taxonomyId, shippingProfileId (pictures and the digital file are set when the draft is made, change them on Etsy). ELO asks Etsy for the state of the listing first, so a draft that was activated a minute ago is refused. A pending id (pending-N) changes the draft that is waiting for the shop to be connected. Every call is logged.
